issue.title: Cleanup submit-worker failures leave killed or dismissed agents hidden
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** , , , and 

When the durable cleanup submit worker fails before the cleanup proc starts, reproduce by making  raise after the TUI has tombstoned a kill or dismiss selection. The completion path only reports the failure toast: it lacks , so dismissed or tombstoned rows remain hidden, and kill escalation is skipped. The synchronous rejection path already performs recovery, which distinguishes this asynchronous worker failure.

task_type_fields.impact: Kill and dismiss requests can be half-applied: the UI hides rows and sends SIGTERM, but cleanup persistence never starts, failed rows do not reappear, and kill escalation is skipped.
task_type_fields.repro: Force submit_durable_proc_request to raise in the asynchronous submit worker after a kill or dismiss action has tombstoned the selected rows; observe the failure toast without row resurfacing or kill escalation.

issue.creation_reason: The approved workspace-retention serialization plan identified a separate recovery gap in the durable cleanup submission failure path. Recording it as a distinct bounded bug lets the serialization fix land without conflating recovery behavior.
